metadata.description: Curated Claude Code plugins that ship quality. sniff walks your running app and finds real bugs (accessibility, performance, and broken flows), with an optional source scan. ui-ux-suite audits design across 12 dimensions and cites the named UX law behind every finding. recap-studio builds self-contained offline HTML explainers from any topic or coding session. aws-cost-audit reads your live AWS account read-only, attributes every dollar, and verifies prices live before recommending safe savings. goalify writes the brief and the condition so a fresh session runs a big coding task and comes back with proof it finished. humanizer detects 55 AI writing patterns and rewrites text with sentence-length burstiness, voice profiles, and a 0-100 AI-tell score. loopify writes the brief and the line so Claude Code's built-in /loop keeps a recurring job running on its own and logs what every tick did. Zero bloat. The tool plugins are dual-mode (install as a Claude Code plugin or as a standalone MCP server); aws-cost-audit, goalify, humanizer, and loopify are Claude Code skills (no MCP server).

plugins.name: sniff
plugins.description: AI-powered QA that walks your running app like a user, discovers its flows, and finds real bugs (accessibility, performance, and broken interactions). Auto-detects your dev server. A source scan is also available via `sniff scan`.

plugins.name: ui-ux-suite
plugins.description: Design audit tool. Scores projects across 12 dimensions (color, typography, a11y, layout) and cites the named UX law behind every finding, with primary-source citations. WCAG, APCA, OKLCH color science. Zero dependencies.

plugins.name: recap-studio
plugins.description: Generate beautiful, mobile-first one-page explainers you can read offline in about 5 minutes. Builds self-contained, offline HTML pages from any topic or coding session, with deterministic heuristic checks that validate clarity, accessibility, and structure before you ship.

plugins.name: aws-cost-audit
plugins.description: Read-only, evidence-first AWS cost audit. Reads your live AWS account, attributes every dollar, finds idle/orphaned/over-provisioned resources, verifies prices live (never hardcoded), and ships a safe, reversible, gated savings plan with confidence levels. A Claude Code skill (no MCP server).

plugins.name: goalify
plugins.description: Hand Claude a huge task. Come back to proof it's done, not a promise that it is. goalify locks the few real decisions and writes the brief (a file holding what the run has to do) plus the condition (one short line you paste into /goal), so a fresh full-context session does the job, quotes the checks passing in its closing turn, and archives the brief to .goal/done/. A Claude Code skill (no MCP server).

plugins.name: humanizer
plugins.description: Detects 55 AI writing patterns and rewrites text with sentence-length burstiness, 5 voice profiles, and a 0-100 AI-tell score. Catches inflated symbolism, promotional language, em dash overuse, rule-of-three, and AI vocabulary. Pure Markdown, zero dependencies, no network calls. A Claude Code skill (no MCP server).

plugins.name: loopify
plugins.description: Hand Claude a job that repeats. Come back to a log of what every tick did, not a loop you have to babysit. loopify reads your project, asks the few real questions, and writes the brief (a standing file the loop re-reads every tick) plus the line (one short string you paste into Claude Code's built-in /loop), with a tick cap, a stop rule, and five safety rails. Every tick logs what it did to TICKS.md. A Claude Code skill (no MCP server).
